accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body:
GDPNow running at 5.8%, which is the kind of number that makes you look under the hood.
The hood is AI and chips carrying a tape with no help from jobless claims at 199k a month.
Fine for now. I'm watching how narrow the leadership gets from here.

accounts.name: Founder's desk — the day's tape, first person

queue.body:
Jobless claims averaging 199K a week this month, 11.9% below a year ago.
Atlanta Fed GDPNow at a 5.8% annual rate this quarter.
Cleveland Fed median CPI running at a 2.1% annual rate.
I don't know what you do with a macro picture this clean except admit it is clean.
$PI held its 30-week for the 5th time in three years. That's a lot of second chances.
New highs are nice. Staying near them after a run like that is what I actually watch. $APH

queue.body: UTI crashed -34.2% on Thursday. UTI has been crossing its 50-day average in both directions lately, which is the context the number needs.
